piece.headline: KHAMANKAR SNATCHES THE LEAD, HITESH LEFT FUMING
piece.standfirst: Aryan Khamankar's Free Hit lands a 77-point week and top spot. Hitesh played one too and fell to second.
piece.big_picture: Aryan Khamankar is top of the league, 4 points clear of Hitesh. Both played the Free Hit. Only one made it pay. Yash Bhatia sits third, so this title race now has 3 live contenders.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Utkarsh swapped Elanga and M.Sangaré for Semenyo and Groß. That one move was worth 27 points and lifted him from 42nd to 15th. Sharp, decisive and clearly the transfer of the week.
piece.one_to_watch: Aryan Khamankar leads Hitesh by 4 points. If Hitesh finds a big week while Aryan stumbles, the top spot could swap again. Sahil is only 3 points clear of Kshiteesh at the Big prizes line.

winners.name: Aryan Khamankar
winners.verdict: Best score of the week, the lead taken and a Free Hit that worked. That is nerve backed by skill, and the league has noticed.

winners.name: Zishan
winners.verdict: Matched the top score and jumped 54 places. Nobody saw it coming. Quiet climb, loud result, and a proper skill-or-luck debate for the group chat.

losers.name: Yash Gawai
losers.verdict: Captain Palmer returned just 4 points. The armband did nothing and the slide was 23 places. A week to forget and a captain to rethink.

losers.name: Rahul
losers.verdict: Rahul left 15 points on the bench. The wrong lads got the shirts and the table punished him.

losers.name: Krishna
losers.verdict: Krishna captained Gibbs-White, who returned 4. He also left 14 on the bench. The armband and the team sheet both misfired.
